drivingQuestion: Can a provisional guilt offering or a Paschal offering be brought as a vow or gift, as the mishna's principle requires of everything in its first list?
outcomeNote: Both difficulties against the mishna are answered, but the closing dispute between R' Yannai and R' Yoḥanan over blemished animals is left undecided.

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט לְשֵׁם עוֹלָה. אָשָׁם תָּלוּי בַּר נִידָּר וְנִידָּב הוּא? אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: הָא מַנִּי? רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר הִיא, דְּאָמַר: מִתְנַדֵּב אָדָם אָשָׁם תָּלוּי בְּכׇל יוֹם.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The mishna teaches: In the case of «one who slaughters» an animal and asserts that he is slaughtering it «for the sake of a burnt offering,» for the sake of a peace offering, for the sake of a provisional guilt offering, for the sake of a Paschal offering, or for the sake of a thanks offering, the slaughter is not valid. This is because one who slaughters for the sake of any type of offering that is consecrated as a vow or as a gift renders the animal forbidden. The Gemara asks: «Is a provisional guilt offering fit» to be consecrated as «a vow or» as «a gift?» A provisional guilt offering is brought only when one is obligated to do so due to uncertainty whether or not he is liable to bring a sin offering. «Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» In accordance with «whose» opinion «is this» halakha in the mishna? «It is» in accordance with the opinion of «Rabbi Elazar, who says» in a mishna (Karetot 25a): «A person donates a provisional guilt offering every day» if he chooses, due to concern that perhaps he violated a prohibition.

segments.he: פֶּסַח בַּר נִידָּב וְנִידָּר הוּא? זִמְנָא קְבִיעָא לֵיהּ! אָמַר רַבִּי אוֹשַׁעְיָא: שָׁאנֵי פֶּסַח, הוֹאִיל וְהַפְרָשָׁתוֹ כׇּל הַשָּׁנָה כּוּלָּהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «Is a Paschal offering fit» to be consecrated as «a vow or» as «a gift? The time is fixed for its» offering on Passover eve, when bringing it is an obligation, and it may not be brought on any other day. «Rabbi Oshaya said: The Paschal offering is different, since» although the date for bringing and slaughtering it is the fourteenth of Nisan, «its designation» can be performed «throughout the entire year.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יַנַּאי: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא תְּמִימִים, אֲבָל בַּעֲלֵי מוּמִין – מִידָּע יְדִיעַ. וְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: אֲפִילּוּ בַּעֲלֵי מוּמִין נָמֵי, זִימְנִין דִּרְמֵי לֵיהּ מִידֵּי אַמּוּמָא וְלָא יְדִיעַ.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yannai says:» The Sages «taught» that slaughter of an animal for the sake of an offering is not valid «only» if the animals were «unblemished. But» with regard to animals with «blemishes,» the slaughterer «knows» that they are blemished and disqualified from sacrifice. Therefore, despite his declaration, there is no concern that his actual intent was to slaughter the animal for that purpose. «And Rabbi Yoḥanan says:» Slaughter of an animal for the sake of an offering is not valid «even» if the animals were «blemished as well,» as there are «times that an item is cast over the blemish» and covers it, «and he does not know» that the animal is blemished.

moves.cueHe: אשם תלוי בר נידר ונידב הוא?
moves.summary: a provisional guilt offering is obligatory, so it should not fall under the mishna's rule about vowed offerings
moves.about: whether a provisional guilt offering, which is brought only out of obligation where there is doubt, can be consecrated by vow or gift as the mishna's principle requires

moves.summary: R' Yoḥanan assigns the mishna to R' Elazar, who holds a provisional guilt offering may be donated daily
moves.about: the anonymous mishna's inclusion of a provisional guilt offering among vowed offerings follows R' Elazar

moves.summary: the Paschal offering has a fixed time, so it too should not be a vowed or donated offering
moves.about: whether the Paschal offering, whose time is fixed on the eve of Passover, can be consecrated by vow or gift

moves.summary: the Paschal offering is different because it may be designated all year long
moves.about: the Paschal offering is different because, though its slaughter has a fixed time, it may be designated throughout the year

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי ינאי: לא שנו אלא תמימים
moves.summary: R' Yannai limits the mishna's disqualification to unblemished animals
moves.about: the mishna's disqualification was taught only of unblemished animals, since with a blemished animal everyone knows it cannot be sacrificed

moves.cueHe: ורבי יוחנן אמר: אפילו בעלי מומין נמי
moves.summary: R' Yoḥanan extends it to blemished animals, since something may be lying over the blemish
moves.about: whether the mishna's disqualification applies also when the animal is blemished and its unfitness is evident
